reason: The sole operative paragraph of EO 11320 reads "The Secretary of State, and, when designated by the Secretary of" State the Under Secretary of State are empowered to exercise the President's rulemaking authority under section 7 of the Foreign Gifts and Decorations Act of 1966. EO 12553, signed by the President on 1986-02-25 and published at 51 FR 7237 on 1986-03-03, orders that the listed Executive Orders, and any amendments thereto, "are revoked:" and its list includes "11320 Delegating authority to prescribe rules and regulations relating to foreign gifts and decorations". EO 12553 states no later effective date, so the revocation took effect on signing, 1986-02-25, by the President as actor. No earlier end is shown in held text.
